note: Doctrinal taxonomies used as tags. Cite released doctrine only: JP 3-04 (2022) is not public; its aspects are confirmed through the 2023 DoD Strategy for Operations in the Information Environment (SOIE) glossary and the 2018 Joint Concept for Operating in the Information Environment.

ie_aspect.basis: Joint Concept for Operating in the Information Environment (2018); SOIE (2023) glossary quoting JP 3-04

values.informational: Information itself: content, data, networks that carry it.
values.physical: Physical means and places: infrastructure, sensors, terrain, spectrum.
values.human: How people and groups perceive, decide and act.

ie_aspect.crosswalk_note: Old JP 3-13 dimension tags (physical, informational, cognitive) and NATO AJP-10's virtual map onto the current aspects.

pmesii_pt.basis: FM 3-0 (2022) operational variables; JP 2-01.3 (2014) uses PMESII

values.people: People (as populations and groups; never individuals)

continuum.basis: Competition continuum (JP 1, JP 3-0; Joint Concept for Competing, 2023)
